audits.claim_text: Under the frozen remediated E3 contract, the complete Qwen3.5-9B run yields 263 EQUIV-FIXPOINT, 61 DIVERGE_CONFIRMED, 61 REFUSED, and 3 invalid-candidate preparation outcomes over all 388 cases.
audits.scope: All 388 confirmed ir_gt and binding_gt rows; Hyper-AI/Qwen3.5-9B-fp8; fresh candidates with a lineage-recorded technical continuation for 126 connection failures; horizon-free Explorer.

run_selection.selection_rule: Include every one of the 388 frozen case IDs exactly once in final accounting; no outcome-based case exclusion.

evidence_artifacts.kind: complete candidate manifest after technical continuation

check_results.rationale: Payloads, model, sampling, source hashes, caps, and unconditional denominator were fixed before candidate generation; only connection-failed cases received a technical continuation.
Positive equivalence requires horizon-free closed-state evidence and divergence requires replay; refusals and invalid candidates are not counted as semantic decisions.
No between-model performance claim is audited here.
The final JSONL contains 388 unique IDs and counts sum exactly to 388; the initial connection failures remain visible in a separate manifest.
The exact descriptive counts and conditional rates follow directly from complete case accounting; no population-generalization or confirmatory claim is made.
Reference/evaluator remediation was informed by predecessor outcomes and the tasks are familiar, so confirmatory interpretation is excluded.
Both initial and completed candidate manifests retain hashes, model identity, payload identity, and the visible technical continuation boundary.
The final evaluator run verified all frozen source hashes before and after evaluation and reported continuity true.
This is a repository-local self-audit without independent evaluation authority or unseen held-out cases.

limitations: WITHDRAWN FROM PAPER USE: prefix postprocessing corrupts confirmed skill identities. The 57 capability failures cannot be attributed to Qwen; aggregate model-performance claims require a corrected complete run with raw outputs retained.
The evidence is exploratory because predecessor outcomes informed contract remediation.
61 REFUSED and 3 invalid candidates have no semantic equivalence verdict.
The technical continuation is not an independent replication.
Repository-local hashes do not establish external execution isolation.

predecessor_failures.rationale: Confirmed IR/binding injection and static contract validation remove the identified cross-stage mismatch.
Exactly the connection-failed artifacts were retained and technically continued; the completed manifest has 388 matching payloads and no generation errors.
No authoritative TargetTemperature bound was invented; the case remains outside the supported numeric fragment.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: For confirmatory evidence, freeze a previously unseen held-out case set and run it once without outcome-informed semantic, data, prompt, or evaluator changes.
